m: सम्-ऊढ See under सम्- √ 1. ऊह्.
सम्-ऊढ mfn. (or -ऊ|अ) swept or pressed together, brought together, collected, united, RV.; TS.
regularly arranged, restored to order (as opp. to व्य्-ऊढ, ‘disarranged’, ‘transposed’), Br.; ŚrS.
purified, L.
tamed, L.
a: समूढ — p. p. 1 Brought together, assembled. --2 Accumulated, collected. --3 Enveloped. --4 Associated with. --5 Produced quickly. --6 Calmed, tamed down, tranquillized. --7 Crooked, bent. --8 Purified, cleansed. --9 Borne along. --10 Led, conducted. --11 Married.

m: सम्-ऊढ—च्छन्दस् mfn. having metres restored to their order, ŚBr.
सम्-ऊढ—द्वादशाह-पद्धति f. N. of wk.
सम्-ऊढ—पुण्डरीक-पद्धति f. N. of wk.
समूढ-रूपिन् m. N. of a partic. form of the Dvādaśāha sacrifice, Drāhy. (Sch.).
सम्-√ ऊह् (cf. सं-√ वह्) P. Ā. -ऊहति, ˚ते (ind.p. -ओहम्, q.v.), to sweep together, bring or gather together, collect, unite, RV.; AV.; Br.; Up.; BhP. : Caus. -ऊहयति, to sweep together, heap up, Kauś.
सम्-√ ऊह् (only Pot. -उह्यात्), to perceive, understand, Vop.
a: समूह् — {c1c} U. To gather, assemble, collect.

m: सम्-ऊहा (आ), f. (scil. वृत्ति) a partic. mode of subsistence, Baudh.

m: सम्-ऊह m. (ifc. f(आ). ) a collection, assemblage, aggregate, heap, number, multitude, AV. &c. &c.
an association, corporation, community, Mn.; Yājñ. &c.
sum, totality, essence, MBh.
N. of a divine being (?), MBh. xiii, 4355
a: समूहः — 1 A multitude, collection, an assemblage, aggregate, number; जनसमूहः, विघ्नसमूहः, पदसमूहः &c. --2 A flock, troop.

m: सम्-ऊह—गन्ध m. civet, L.
सम्-ऊह—कार्य n. the business or affairs of a community, MW.
सम्-˚ऊहक m. collection, heap, multitude, ĀpŚr.; Pañcar.
सम्-ऊह—क्षारक m. civet, L.

m: सम्-˚ऊहनी (ई), f. a broom, Āpast.; Baudh.
सम्-˚ऊहन mfn. sweeping together, collecting, gathering, Mn. iv, 102
सम्-˚ऊहन n. the act of sweeping together &c., ŚāṅkhGṛ.
placing an arrow on the bowstring, L.
a: समूहनं — 1 Bringing together. --2 A collection, plenty.

m: सम्-˚ऊहिन् mfn. forming an aggregate or fit for the formation of an aggregate, Nyāyas., Sch.

m: 1. सम्-ऊह्य mfn. to be swept together &c. (in Śulbas. = समुह्य-पुरीष above), TS.; Kāṭh.
सम्-ऊह्य m. (scil. अग्नि) a kind of sacrificial fire (to be brought or carried by the priest), Pāṇ. iii, 1, 131
a place prepared for the reception of the sacrificial fire, W.
2. सम्-ऊह्य ind. having brought together.
a: समूह्यः — A kind of sacrificial fire.

k.v: अग्नित्रयमिदं त्रेता प्रणीतः संस्कृतोऽनलः। समूह्यः परिचाय्योपचाय्यावग्नौ प्रयोगिणः॥

s: tri, mUlena saha varttamAnam । mUlasahitam । yaTA, -- “aDarmmeREDate rAjaMstato BadrARi paSyati । tataH sapatnAn jayati samUlantu vinaSyati ॥” iti mahABArate SAntiparvvaRi rAjaDarmme yuDizWiraM prati BIzmavAkyam ॥
v: tti॰ rsaha mUlena । mUlasahite “samUle upapade kazAdiByaH Ramul tatprakftiDAtoranuprayogaSca “samUlakAzaM ca kazuH” “samUlaGAtaM nyabaDAt” iti ca BawwiH ।
m: स-मूल mfn. having roots, overgrown, grassy, green, verdant, ŚBr.; Kauś.; R.
together with the root, root and branch, entire or entirely (also ibc. and अम् ind.), Br. &c. &c.
based upon, founded, Gobh., Sch.
a: समूल — a. Along with the roots; as in समूलघातं ‘having completely exterminated, tearing up root and branch’.

m: स-मूल—घातम् ind. with utter extirpation (with √ हन्, ‘to destroy utterly’), Śiś.; Sarvad.
स-मूल—काषम् ind. with root and branch (with √ कष्, ‘to exterminate completely’), Mcar.; Sarvad.
स-मूलक mfn. together with the roots, MBh.
together with radish-root, ib.
स-मूलम् (अम्), ind., entirely
समूर or समूरु m. a kind of deer (the skin of which may be used as a student's seat &c.; accord. to some it has a white mane; cf. चमूरु), L.
a: समूरः, समूरुः, समूरकः — A kind of deer.

m: समूर्तक (prob.) w.r. for संवर्तक, MārkP.

v: pu॰ saNgatO sanDihInatvAt UrUyasya । mfgaBede amaraH pfzo॰ । samUra tatrArTe pustrA॰ hamaca॰ striyAM NIz ।

k.v: कदली कन्दली चीनश्चमूरुप्रियकावपि। समूरुश्चेति हरिणा अमी अजिनयोनयः॥

m: समूरुक m. id., W.
